title: ever REYA|Stylish Cold Shoulder Flare Sleeves Flowy Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
This romantic cold shoulder bridesmaid dress showcases an cold-shoulder neckline and floor-length skirt with a thigh-high slit. This long flowy bridesmaid dress is suitable for any wedding, evening, party and similar occasion, you can pair it up with chic jewelry and get ready for comfort and style.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is padded, with lining.


Fabric: he garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
